## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link related issues (Fixes #123). -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (node / gizmo / panel / exporter / other)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm run test` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests where practical
- [ ] User-visible text uses i18n keys (English and Persian) — see `docs/I18N_GUIDE.md`
- [ ] Documentation updated (`npm run docs:nodes` for node changes, `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes)
- [ ] No new network requests, analytics, external fonts or CDNs
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are justified and `npm run notices` was run
- [ ] Text, icons and assets are original or under a compatible license (no copied third-party documentation)
